title: ExplainTrace v1
description: Execution-trace contract emitted by `agent-config explain last`. The CLI's --json output is the wire format; the Markdown renderer is a deterministic projection of this same object. See agents/roadmaps/explainability-v2-explain-last.md and the in-tree builder at scripts/_cli/explain_last/.

version.description: Schema version. Bumps require a sibling roadmap; readers MUST refuse unknown versions.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the trace was built (renderer-deterministic only when fixed by the test harness).

run_id.description: Identifier of the originating /work run. Pulled from state.input.data.id, with fallback to the state file mtime serialised as ISO-8601.

subject.description: Originating directive set. `unknown` fires when state.directive_set is absent or unrecognised.

inputs.description: Profile / preset / cost_profile resolution chain. Null when the loader could not resolve any of them (broken settings).

source_per_knob.description: Map<knob, source>; source ∈ pack | profile | preset | user | env | runtime | default.

route.description: Rule-router activation snapshot. Null when router.json is absent.

council.description: List of council member responses attached to this run. Null when no session file matched the run window.

memory.description: Memory-MCP hits that influenced this run. Null when no memory layer was consulted.

pack.description: Active workspace pack selection. Null when no pack was active.

assumptions.description: Assumptions the engine recorded; empty list when none were captured.

halt.description: Most recent halt persisted by the engine. Null on clean runs.

provider.description: Video provider selection record. Non-null only when state.directive_set == 'video' AND state.video_provider was written.
